build_model_config_xcit_tiny: build an XCiT tiny model config with patch_size=8, embed_dim=192, depth=12 for ADE20K semantic segmentation
configure_upernet_decoder: configure the UPerNet decoder head with in_channels=[192,192,192,192] and 150 classes for ADE20K
setup_adamw_optimizer: setup AdamW optimizer with lr=0.00006, weight_decay=0.01, and zero weight decay for position embeddings and norms
configure_lr_scheduler: configure poly learning rate schedule with linear warmup over 1500 iterations for XCiT training
configure_data_loader: configure data loader with 2 samples per GPU for 8-GPU distributed training on ADE20K dataset
